name: Reputation Level 1
who_knows_about_you: Anyone who was there at the time knows.
text: Anyone who was there at the time knows.
transcription_note: Scale p194 (printed 193). Most Cyberpunk RED Characters start at Reputation 0 (no row; Level 0 is not a printed row). Facedown (p195): COOL + Reputation + 1d10; a defining event for cowardice makes the Level negative. Recognition roll: 1d10 under the Level.
